function.name: victorialogs_query
function.description: Run one LogsQL query on VictoriaLogs and read its rows, one per line. A log entry reads as its time, its stream values, its level and its message; the output of a pipe (stats, top, field_names, field_values, fields) reads as key=value pairs. Start with a time filter like _time:1h, add words or "phrases" of the message, or field:value filters on other fields, then pipes: | sort by (_time), | stats by (field) count() n, | stats by (_time:10m) count() n, | top 10 by (field), | field_names, | field_values field, | fields a, b. Rows come unordered unless sorted.

query.title: LogsQL query, starting with a time filter like _time:1h

limit.title: Maximum number of rows, 100 by default, 1000 at most
